diagnosis.method: Instrumented single trials on the frozen schema-1 circuit (game index 4362, seed 42+index, weight scale 0.5), all 4,064 KCs and 17 DANs sampled per 10 ms bin; gains reset before each probe.
diagnosis.mechanism: The schema-1 rule multiplied raw DAN spikes. With tonic firing, a KC burst is potentiated immediately by the accumulated dopamine trace while the compensating depression accrues only after the trial ends (tau 500 ms versus 100 ms remaining), so every trial moved gains independently of teaching. Because the active KC set was nearly identical across games, teaching-specific depression also acted on the same synapses for every game. The fixed readout (scale 0.05, clip 4) converted the shared away-compartment depression into 98% away predictions.

weight_scale_sweep.note: Whole-network population spikes per 10 ms bin after stimulus offset stayed at 868 (scale 0.15) to 7,984 (scale 0.5): the graph never returns to rest in this uniform LIF regime.

kc_input_gain_sweep.note: Scratch measurement on four training games; scaling only the synapses onto Kenyon cells. Sparse KC activity silences both readout MBONs and leaves the active KC set 84-94% shared between games.

schema_2_changes: Kernel: plasticity and eligibility traces start at plasticity_onset_ms; each compartment's tonic DAN rate over the preceding dan_baseline_window_ms is subtracted in both rule terms (phasic drive).

Gate: each teaching population must evoke at least min_teaching_evoked_fraction of its scheduled forced spikes above the same-seed unpulsed probe; calibration active-KC-set overlap must not exceed max_kc_code_overlap; tonic DAN rates and post-offset KC persistence are recorded.
Frontend: protocol assumptions, gate rows and per-compartment tonic/scheduled/evoked columns; the newest reward experiment opens first.

schema_3_calibration.method: Scratch sweeps on the first four of the frozen calibration games (train_n 64, validation_n 32, calibration_n 4 selection), 400 ms trials with 300 ms glomerular-tuning-v1 stimulus, all KCs, selected DANs and readout MBONs sampled per 10 ms bin, plasticity off; same metric definitions as the runner gate. Away compartment PAM11/MBON07 unless stated.

old_ports_all_gains_1_antennal_lobe_reve.note: Glomerular encoder, sensory_input_gain 1 (antennal lobe intact), apl_output_gain 1. Whole-network spikes per 10 ms bin stayed at 3,300-7,900 regardless of peak rate and persisted after offset.

labeled_line_ports_kc_gain_at_most_1.note: sensory_input_gain 0: KCs nearly silent at every scale; 500-900 spikes per bin remain from antennal-lobe local neurons.

labeled_line_ports_kc_gain_above_1.note: sensory_input_gain 0, apl_output_gain 1: KCs recover at gain 2-3 and 200 Hz but both readout MBONs stay below 4 Hz because the two APL cells inhibit them more than the active KCs excite them.

apl_output_gain_joint_sweep.note: sensory_input_gain 0, peak 200 Hz. Lowering APL output below 0.25 or raising KC gain above 1.5 re-enters runaway because APL feedback is what sparsens the KCs.

away_compartment_candidates.note: Same drive grid with the away mapping moved to a matched PAM/MBON pair. MBON07 (alpha1) receives 22,840 KC contacts over four cells versus 41,460 over two cells for MBON11 and stayed at or near 0 Hz on at least one calibration game in every non-runaway setting.

diagnostics.reverberation_scale_0.4_kc_gain_0.25_sen: After offset 4,536 neurons fired 103,652 spikes in 100 ms; 3,735 central-brain intrinsic cells carried 94,842 of them. Top cells were ALPNs and antennal-lobe local neurons (lLN1_bc, lLN2P/2T/2X types) at 130-184 spikes per 300 ms, i.e. the refractory ceiling. lLN1_bc is labeled acetylcholine (ground truth) in the released neurotransmitter table; lLN2 types split 44 GABA / 40 acetylcholine.
diagnostics.residual_reverberation_sensory_gain_0_sc: After offset 681 neurons fired 23,364 spikes in 100 ms, again antennal-lobe local neurons plus hygro/thermo receptor neurons; the KC, DAN and MBON populations were silent.
diagnostics.apl_drive_scale_0.5_kc_gain_3_peak_200_a: APL cells 502 and 904 carry 102,263 and 107,649 outgoing contacts (95,542 and 100,658 onto KCs; 270+171 onto MBON11, 129+165 onto MBON07) and receive 108,338 and 102,014 contacts from KCs. They fired 2-3 spikes per 10 ms bin during the stimulus. Summed drive onto MBON11 over one trial: KCs +2,808 mV-spikes from 447 active KCs, APL -4,703; onto MBON07: KCs +1,265 from 213 KCs, APL -3,163.

decision.rationale: Lowest KC density among settings where both readout MBONs exceeded 20 Hz on every calibration game, PAM12 was silent at baseline, PPL101 stayed far below its refractory ceiling, the network returned toward rest after offset and the four-game KC-set overlap was 0.31.

gain_diagnosis.training_mean_ppl101_spikes_per_10ms_bin: about 0.84 during 50-100 ms and 0.85 during 100-300 ms; the tonic estimate is unbiased on average but single-trial noisy with two cells
gain_diagnosis.mechanism: Learning now occurs on a circuit that passes every gate, but the gain change is dominated by a component shared between true and shuffled teaching: the away compartment (PAM12, silent unless taught) is depressed on the KC core that overlaps between games (mean Jaccard 0.30), and the home compartment (PPL101, about 44 Hz tonic from real KC-to-DAN edges) is potentiated by rule noise around a two-cell tonic estimate. The fixed readout is centered on the untrained circuit, so a shared shift of the taught MBONs reads as a class bias on every validation game. Teaching-specific gain differences exist but are seven times smaller than the shared component.
